prompts.01-spacer: 做一个单色3D打印的定位垫块，长32、宽20、高6毫米，中心有直径5毫米的贯穿孔，外部竖边圆角1毫米；平底，无其他装配件。生成可编辑参数模型和STEP及打印工件，按项目流程完成验证。最终给出实际尺寸、孔径与位置、编译状态，并保留未解决的问题。
prompts.02-document-only: 模型已经确定，本次只补使用说明：在README.md中记录垫块的目标尺寸32×20×6 mm、中心贯穿孔5 mm、外部竖边圆角1 mm，以及刚才实际验证的结果和未解决问题。保持几何、设计和制造声明文件不变。
prompts.03-repeat-evidence: 把刚才这个垫块的实际尺寸、当前验证状态和已有工件链接再汇总一次即可，模型需求和输入没有变化。

outcomes: SDK-reported usage with unavailable fields left unknown
native image tool calls and matching image payloads
exact geometry dimensions and hole/corner features
protocol.limits: Exploratory paired cases; no statistical quality/speed generalization. Failed and interrupted cases are retained. Dedicated seeded inspection case will be frozen before either arm runs it.

inspectionPlan.fixture: 37-degree rotated rectangular internal L channel with separate opaque side cover
inspectionPlan.prompt: 当前工作区已有一份绑定的草稿，含 channel-body 和 outer-cover 两个对象；默认总览不能清楚显示侧开口和内部通道。请基于当前实际几何检查：侧开口是否连通内部通道、外罩是否遮挡该开口，以及内部直角转弯是否连通。请提供支持判断的局部视图与剖面证据，并说明证据范围和不能证明的内容。观察的对象、方向、局部范围和剖面由你根据几何自行判断。不要修改或重建模型，本次不做制造验收。
inspectionPlan.evidenceBoundary: An existing-draft inspection task, separate from the complete spacer modeling task.

prompts.05-declaration-only.txt: 只完善 intent 中外形尺寸的证据说明：明确这些尺寸来自用户给定的名义 CAD 目标，不是实物测量。尺寸、容差、几何与制造约束都不变，已有几何证据足够。按现有冻结 intent 的修订规则保存，并完成声明所需的验证；保留原冻结版本和 STEP，不修改模型。

notes: Fresh-session usage is its SDK total; resumed-turn usage is the difference from the prior completed turn in the same session. Trace token_count totals were cross-checked against SDK snapshots.
Cached input is a subset of input, and reasoning output a subset of output. Do not add these subsets to totals.
Model response count is distinct increasing token_count total records; native tool calls and commands are separate denominators.
These are exploratory single paired cases; model stochasticity, sequential order and cache effects prevent causal speed/quality claims.

sections.label: z=0.1
notes: Coordinates are the input part coordinates; no print-pose transform is applied.
BRep intersections and bounds retain kernel precision; areas use adaptive integration with relative target 1e-9, not mesh sampling.
Width u and depth v follow the reported plane axes; center is the outer bounds midpoint, not a centroid.
Material islands are section faces per solid; holes are their bounded inner loops, not proven through passages.
Areas are summed per solid without unioning overlaps; overlapping solids can double count material.
Empty means no positive-area section returned; a tangent plane may still touch an edge or point. Inspect nearby specified planes when needed.
Finite sections do not prove global wall thickness, connectivity, or satisfaction of unsampled requirements.
